title: Load Test the Service and Name the Bottleneck
objective: Run a repeatable load script against the containerized service, record percentile latencies, name the bottleneck with attached evidence, and rerun the same script after one change.
whyThisMatters: A service that is 'fast on my machine' has no capacity story. The capstone SLO and the failure drill both need a measured baseline you can point at.
evidence: The committed load script and the exact command line used for both runs
Two run reports (baseline and after the change) each listing p50, p95, p99, error rate, duration, and offered load
A bottleneck note that points at a specific file, query plan, or metric sample — not a guess
The single change made after the baseline, as its own commit
Git history showing script, baseline report, change, then second report, in that order
acceptanceCriteria: The load script is committed and the README names the exact command to rerun it against the containerized service.
Both committed reports list p50, p95, p99, error rate, duration, and the offered load (requests per second or concurrent callers).
The bottleneck note cites a specific file, EXPLAIN plan, or metric sample collected during the baseline run.
The second run uses the same script and the same load parameters as the first.
